metas.name: Superman
metas.description: Superman must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as reporter Clark Kent. As the embodiment of truth, justice and the American way he soon finds himself in a world that views these as old-fashioned.

metas.name: The Love Hypothesis
metas.description: After an impulsive kiss, two scientists end up in a fake relationship, testing their theories about love and each other.

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: The Gentlemen
metas.description: An American expat tries to sell off his highly profitable marijuana empire in London, triggering plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.

metas.name: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
metas.description: A mother personally challenges the local authorities to solve her daughter's murder when they fail to catch the culprit.

metas.name: Coyote vs. Acme
metas.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

metas.name: I Swear
metas.description: John Davidson: diagnosed with Tourette's syndrome at a young age which alienated him from his peers, he struggled with a condition few people had witnessed.

metas.name: Practical Magic 2
metas.description: A multi generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

metas.name: Nativity!
metas.description: An uptight but secretly heartbroken primary school teacher's little white lie about Hollywood coming to see his class' nativity play grows like wildfire in his rag-tag school low on self-esteem.

metas.name: The Matrix
metas.description: A computer hacker discovers that his life is nothing more than an elaborate simulation run by an evil AI.

metas.name: Evil Dead Burn
metas.description: After the loss of her husband, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws. As one by one they transform into deadites, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life - survive even in death.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

metas.name: Send Help
metas.description: An overworked analyst and her arrogant nepo-baby boss survive a plane crash near Thailand and must cooperate to survive on a remote jungle island while their workplace power dynamic collapses around them.

metas.name: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
metas.description: Once a lone bounty hunter, Mandalorian Din Djarin and his apprentice Grogu embark on an exciting new Star Wars adventure.

metas.name: Love Actually
metas.description: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

metas.name: Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

metas.name: Violent Night
metas.description: When an elite team of mercenaries breaks into a family compound on Christmas Eve, a disgruntled Santa Claus must take them out to save both the hostages and his Holiday.

metas.name: 12 Angry Men
metas.description: The jury in a New York City murder trial is frustrated by a single member whose skeptical caution forces them to more carefully consider the evidence before jumping to a hasty verdict.

metas.name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
metas.description: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.

metas.name: The Usual Suspects
metas.description: The sole survivor of a pier shoot-out tells the story of how a notorious criminal influenced the events that began with five criminals meeting in a seemingly random police lineup.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
metas.description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

metas.name: Minions & Monsters
metas.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.

metas.name: Bad Apples
metas.description: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

metas.name: Whiplash
metas.description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: A meticulous jewel thief risks his flawless record against an equally obsessive detective and a volatile rival, while an underestimated insurance broker turns accomplice after decades of professional disrespect.

metas.name: Nosferatu
metas.description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

metas.name: Eyes Wide Shut
metas.description: A Manhattan doctor embarks on a bizarre, night-long odyssey after his wife's admission of unfulfilled longing.

metas.name: Meet the Parents
metas.description: A chronic underachiever meets his girlfriend's parents before proposing, but unfortunately for him her father is an overprotective former CIA agent.

metas.name: The Nice Guys
metas.description: In 1970s Los Angeles, a mismatched pair of private eyes investigate a missing girl and the mysterious death of a porn star.

metas.name: The Silence of the Lambs
metas.description: A young FBI cadet is aided by a manipulative cannibal killer in her pursuit of a madman who skins his victims.

metas.name: One Night Only
metas.description: Two New Yorkers search for love on the one night of the year when pre-marital sex is legal.

metas.name: Good Will Hunting
metas.description: A therapist counsels Will Hunting, a janitor with a genius IQ.

metas.name: Thunderbolts*
metas.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must go on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

metas.name: Troy
metas.description: An adaptation of Homer's great epic, the film follows the assault on Troy by the united Greek forces.

metas.name: The Sixth Sense
metas.description: After being shot by a resentful former patient whom he failed to help, a Philadelphia child psychologist seeks redemption by treating a young boy with a disturbing secret.

metas.name: GoodFellas
metas.description: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mafia, covering his relationship with his wife Karen and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito.

metas.name: Schindler's List
metas.description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

metas.name: Kindergarten Cop
metas.description: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher in order to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

metas.name: City of God
metas.description: In the slums of Rio, two kids' paths diverge as one struggles to become a photographer and the other a kingpin.

metas.name: Avengers: Infinity War
metas.description: The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.

metas.name: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
metas.description: On the outskirts of Whoville lives a green, revenge-seeking Grinch who plans to ruin Christmas for all of the citizens of the town.

metas.name: Anora
metas.description: A young stripper from Brooklyn impulsively marries the son of Russian oligarchs, but her fairy tale is threatened when his parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.

metas.name: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
metas.description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: The Town
metas.description: A proficient group of thieves rob a bank and hold the manager hostage. Things begin to get complicated when one of the crew members falls in love with her.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

metas.name: Hamnet
metas.description: In late 16th-century England, Agnes, a healer sensitive to the world around her, builds a home with William, a local tutor and aspiring playwright. As their lives fracture, they are tested by distance, silence, and grief.

metas.name: Memento
metas.description: A former insurance investigator who now suffers from anterograde amnesia uses notes and tattoos to hunt down his wife's murderer.

metas.name: Me Before You
metas.description: A girl in a small town forms an unlikely bond with a recently-paralyzed man she's taking care of.

metas.name: It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
metas.description: The Peanuts gang celebrates Halloween while Linus waits for the Great Pumpkin.

metas.name: F1: The Movie
metas.description: A Formula One driver comes out of retirement to mentor and team up with a younger driver.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: Avengers: Age of Ultron
metas.description: When Tony Stark and Bruce Banner try to jump-start a dormant peacekeeping program called Ultron, things go horribly wrong and it's up to Earth's mightiest heroes to stop the villainous Ultron from enacting his terrible plan.

metas.name: Gone Girl
metas.description: The husband of a missing woman becomes the main suspect in her disappearance.

metas.name: X-Men
metas.description: In a world where mutants (evolved super-powered humans) exist and are discriminated against, two groups form for an inevitable clash: the supremacist Brotherhood, and the pacifist X-Men.

metas.name: Oldboy
metas.description: After being kidnapped and imprisoned for fifteen years, Oh Dae-Su is released, only to find that he must track down his captor in five days.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: Two US marshals are sent to a mental institution on an inhospitable island in order to investigate the disappearance of a patient.

metas.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

metas.name: Leviticus
metas.description: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other.

metas.name: The Rip
metas.description: A group of Miami cops discovers a stash of millions in cash, leading to distrust as outsiders learn about the huge seizure, making them question who to rely on.

metas.name: Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

metas.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

metas.name: The Green Mile
metas.description: A death row guard learns that a gentle giant in his charge possesses a mysterious gift.

metas.name: The Dreamers
metas.description: In 1968 Paris, film-loving twins Theo and Isabelle befriend American student Matthew during student protests. While their parents travel, they pull him into a month of sensual exploration, until reality intrudes.

metas.name: King Arthur: Legend of the Sword
metas.description: Robbed of his birthright, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword from the stone, he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy - whether he likes it or not.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: Gladiator
metas.description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

metas.name: Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: Jill leaves voice messages to her deceased sister telling her about her chaotic life in San Francisco. Unwittingly, a mysterious Austin TX real estate agent begins to receive their confessions..

metas.name: Nocturnal Animals
metas.description: A wealthy art gallery owner is haunted by her ex-husband's novel, her memories of their relationship, and her regrets about her life.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: Follow the final recruits of a grueling special ops boot camp who encounter a mysterious deadly force.

metas.name: In Bruges
metas.description: After a job gone wrong, hitman Ray and his partner await orders from their ruthless boss in Bruges, Belgium, the last place in the world Ray wants to be.

metas.name: Deadpool & Wolverine
metas.description: Deadpool is offered a place in the Marvel Cinematic Universe by the Time Variance Authority, but instead recruits a variant of Wolverine to save his universe from extinction.

metas.name: Forrest Gump
metas.description: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

metas.name: Evil Dead Rise
metas.description: A twisted tale of two estranged sisters whose reunion is cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

metas.name: Seven Psychopaths
metas.description: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

metas.name: Saving Private Ryan
metas.description: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.

metas.name: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
metas.description: Mario ventures into space, exploring cosmic worlds and tackling galactic challenges far from the familiar Mushroom Kingdom.

metas.name: The Avengers
metas.description: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

metas.name: Wuthering Heights
metas.description: A passionate and tumultuous love story set against the backdrop of the Yorkshire moors, exploring the intense and destructive relationship between Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw.

metas.name: Django Unchained
metas.description: With the help of a German bounty-hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner in Mississippi.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: Twins journey to the Middle East to discover their family history and fulfill their mother's last wishes.

metas.name: Dead Poets Society
metas.description: A maverick teacher at a prestigious New England boys' boarding school uses poetry to embolden his pupils to new heights of self-expression.

metas.name: Pride & Prejudice
metas.description: When Elizabeth Bennet meets the handsome Mr. Darcy, she believes he is the last man she could ever marry, but as their lives become intertwined, she finds herself captivated by the man she has sworn to hate forever.

metas.name: Haunted Mansion
metas.description: A single mom named Gabbie hires a tour guide, a psychic, a priest and a historian to help exorcise her newly bought mansion after discovering it is inhabited by ghosts.

metas.name: V for Vendetta
metas.description: A young woman living in a dystopian society meets a shadowy freedom fighter who is plotting to overthrow their tyrannical government.

metas.name: It's a Wonderful Life
metas.description: An angel is sent from Heaven to help a desperately frustrated businessman see the value of his own life.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Linguist Louise Banks leads a team of investigators when gigantic spaceships touch down around the world. As nations teeter on the verge of global war, Banks and her crew must find a way to communicate with the extraterrestrial vi...

metas.name: Mud
metas.description: On a Mississippi River island, two young boys encounter a stranger who tells wild tales about bounty hunters and a beautiful woman.

metas.name: Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

metas.name: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: When her fiancé uses their "celebrity pass" agreement, Midwest bride Gail Daughtry travels to Hollywood seeking revenge by pursuing her own celebrity encounter.

metas.name: Those Who Wish Me Dead
metas.description: A teenage murder witness finds himself pursued by twin assassins in the Montana wilderness with a survival expert tasked with protecting him -- and a forest fire threatening to consume them all.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.

metas.name: Apex
metas.description: A mountain climber haunted by a fatal decision in Norway retreats to the Australian wilderness for isolation. Her journey turns into a desperate hunt when a deceptive local targets her as his next ritualistic prey in the bush.

metas.name: Die Hard
metas.description: A New York City cop tries to save his wife and several others taken hostage by terrorists during a Christmas party in a Los Angeles skyscraper.

metas.name: The Holiday
metas.description: Amanda lives in LA and is a movie trailer editor. Iris lives in Surrey and is a journalist. The two decide to swap houses for two weeks at Christmas - both trying to forget their troubled love lives, until love finds them anyway.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: A grieving family is haunted by tragic and disturbing occurrences.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A young aristocrat falls in love with a poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated RMS Titanic.

metas.name: Apocalypse Now
metas.description: A U.S. Army officer serving in Vietnam is tasked with assassinating a renegade Special Forces Colonel who sees himself as a god.

metas.name: Top Gun: Maverick
metas.description: The story involves Maverick confronting his past while training a group of younger Top Gun graduates, including the son of his deceased best friend, for a dangerous mission.

metas.name: Cold Storage
metas.description: When a highly dangerous fungus escapes from a secret laboratory, a former bioterrorism agent is called back into action. Alongside two young employees, he must confront an invisible and out-of-control threat.
